social_activities:
Worked for the protection of environment and for bringing in social reforms with the help of NGOs like Nehru Yuva Kendra.
I have always regarded the preservation and promotion of language, literature and culture as a vital responsibility. With this commitment, I played an important role in strengthening the Chhattisgarh Rajbhasha Commission and promoting the Chattisgarhi language. Key initiatives included the publication of the Chattisgarhi Dictionary, the introduction of a Master’s degree programme in Chhattisgarhi, and efforts to ensure that this academic qualification was recognized for eligibility in relevant Government employment.
hobbies:
Singing and book reading
Having a keen interest in regarding the literary works of renowned writers. I am particularly fond of the works of Swami Vivekananda and draw self-inspiration from them. Whenever I get time, I read the works of ancient scholars such as Valmiki (Ramayan), Kalidasa (Meghadutam), and Banabhatta (Kadambari) I also enjoy reading Chhattisgarhi literature and folklore.
sports:
Badminton 
Due to continuous efforts, Raipur now has an international cricket stadium and has emerged on the world map of cricket. Being the office-bearer and now the Patron of the State Body Builders Federation and the Archery Federation, he has been making every effort to promote these sports in Chhattisgarh.
countries_visited: Sri Lanka, Singapore, Malaysia, Japan, China, Macau, Switzerland, Netherlands, France, Spain, the United Kingdom, the United States of America (US), Canada and Israel
